$comment: Forbidden-identifier rules for the MentorRecorder hard boundary.
The patterns live in this data file (not in check.py) so that the
checker's own source contains no literal match. This directory is
itself excluded from the scan. See docs/privacy-boundary.md.
'contracts/' is deliberately not scanned: the IPC schema states the boundary
in prose ('no TCP, no WebSocket'), which is documentation, not code.
'scan_dirs' are walked recursively; 'scan_files' are individual files
relative to the repository root (the root CMakeLists.txt and the shared
MSBuild files live there and would otherwise never be looked at).
'installer' and '.github' are scanned as of the 2026-09-21 audit (finding 6):
installer/MentorRecorder.iss ships with every release and runs elevated, and
the CI workflows execute third-party code, so both are exactly the kind of
file the boundary has to hold for. Their extensions '.iss' and '.isl' were
added for the same reason.
Exclusions (audit 2026-10-03, R2T-1): 'exclude_dir_names' are skipped wherever the
walk meets them and may only name directories that never hold a source file of ours
(.git, .vs, __pycache__, node_modules). Build output, 'exclude_output_dir_names' (bin,
obj), is skipped only directly inside a directory holding a .csproj: the .NET SDK leaves
only <project>/bin and <project>/obj out of its default compile glob, so a bin/ or obj/
deeper down is compiled and is scanned (V5-7). Every other exclusion is an exact
repository-relative path in 'exclude_paths' that must exist as written and lie inside
a scan root without swallowing one. A directory called build/ or packages/ inside
src/ is therefore scanned like any other, and so is every dot-directory, including
the public-repository mirror tools/shared-calibration/public-repo/.github/. A
configured scan root, scan file or exclusion that does not exist, and a symbolic link
or junction to a directory inside a scan root, fail the run (R2T-6).
Every 'pattern' is a Python regular expression matched per line.
A line may lift ONE rule with '<allow_marker>(<RULE-ID>): <reason>', for example
'BOUNDARY-ALLOW(INJ-008): named only to say why it is not used' (use it only for
boundary-enforcing code that must name a forbidden symbol, or for a file's single
hit that is not the forbidden thing at all). It lifts one hit of that rule on
that line and nothing else; a bare marker or one without a reason lifts nothing, a
marker naming an undeclared rule id fails the run, and every honoured marker is
listed with the text it lifted in the text and JSON output (audit 2026-10-03, ON2-5).
Every marker is pinned in 'allow_markers' by file, rule and 'match', the exact text of
the one hit it lifts, one entry per marker: an unpinned marker lifts nothing and fails
the run, as do a marker that lifts no hit on its line, a pinned marker the scan does not
find (R2T-4), and a marker whose line holds more than that one hit of its rule or
another hit in its place (V5-3), so a second call added to a marked line is reported.
A candidate file that cannot be stat-ed or read, is over max_file_bytes or holds
NUL bytes fails the run (exit 2), as do a directory that cannot be listed and a run
that scanned nothing; an include_extensions entry must be a lower-case suffix with
its dot (ON2-6).
INJ-009 (Process members that open a handle to their process) allows, by exact path,
only code that drives OUR OWN processes: the Collector's parent watchdog, which
waits on the Desktop and reads its start time; the integration and unit tests that
start, wait for and kill the Collector or a stand-in parent; and the scripts and one
packaging test that run child processes (dotnet, the Collector, static-analysis
tools). Shipped capture code that touches the game process is never allowed
(docs/privacy-boundary.md section 2, rule 3b). A file with a single hit that is not a
Process member at all carries a pinned line marker instead of a whole-file allowance
(R2T-5): CommandLineOptions.cs names Process.StartTime in a doc comment as the format
of --parent-start, and RecoveryEndToEndTests.cs reads ExitCode of a result record.
SqliteDatabase.cs and DatabaseIntegrityCheckTests.cs read SqliteConnection.Handle, SQLite's
own handle for a database connection, to interrupt or watch an integrity check. A per-line
pattern cannot tell that member from Process.Handle without knowing the type, and any
spelling it could key on would let a process handle through under the same spelling, so
each such line carries a pinned marker (audit 2026-10-03, CS5-X1).
INJ-008 and INJ-009 also match a member after whitespace following the dot, and in C#
property patterns and object initialisers, where the name follows '{' or ',' or starts
the line and is followed by ':', '.' or '=' (V5-2).
INJ-009 also matches a PowerShell pipeline that names one of its members without a dot
(S33-9): a process source on the line (Get-Process, gps, ps, or [Process]::GetProcesses*)
and, after a later '|', Select-Object, ForEach-Object, Sort-Object, Where-Object,
Group-Object, Measure-Object, Format-Table or Format-List (or select, foreach, %, sort,
where, ?, group, measure, ft, fl) with the member among its arguments, in any letter case
and not after a '#'. The process source is what tells 'Get-Process | Sort-Object StartTime'
from '$runs | Sort-Object StartTime'; inside a string the pipeline still counts, because a
string handed to powershell -Command runs it.
installer/MentorRecorder.iss creates its Inno Setup download page on one line, which
carries a pinned NET-009 marker (V5-4; until then the whole file was allowed): when
Npcap is missing, Setup downloads the official Npcap installer (pinned version, SHA-256
checked) and starts it, because Npcap's free licence forbids bundling it; see
README.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The Inno Setup patterns match a call, not the
bare name, so the stock translation file installer/ChineseSimplified.isl, which names
DownloadTemporaryFile in a section heading, needs no allowance.
A rule entry may carry 'only_extensions': it then applies to those file types only, so
a pattern written for one language's syntax is not matched against another's prose.
NET-009/qml-remote reads QML and JavaScript only; NET-009/shell-commands reads only
script and workflow files, and matches curl, wget, iwr, irm, bitsadmin and
certutil -urlcache at command position (line start, or after ; | & ( { = @ ! a backtick
or 'run:'; also after the shell words if then do else elif while until and sudo, behind
cmd /c and Start-Process, quoted after the call operator &, and with a path in front),
outside a '#' comment and outside other quoted text, and not followed by a letter, a
digit, '.', '-' or '_', so prose, identifiers and tools that merely contain those words
do not trip it (V5-5).
NET-009/xml-loads (S33-9) refuses an XML reader handed a remote address, which it then
downloads itself: '.Load(' or ']::Load(' whose first argument is an http(s) literal
(XmlDocument, XDocument, XElement, PowerShell's $doc.Load and [XDocument]::Load, MSXML's
load in Pascal), XmlReader.Create with such a literal, and XmlTextReader or XPathDocument
whose first string literal on the line is one; in any letter case. A local path, or an
address held in a variable, does not trip it. PowerShell's [xml] cast of a download needs
no pattern of its own: WebClient, Invoke-WebRequest and iwr / irm in it already trip NET-006
and NET-009.
NET-010 (S33-9) reads Python files only. It refuses the import of a network module
(urllib.request, urllib3, http.client, requests, httpx, aiohttp, socket, ftplib, smtplib,
poplib, imaplib, nntplib, telnetlib, xmlrpc.client, websockets) as an import or from
statement, as 'from urllib|http|xmlrpc import request|client', or through __import__ /
importlib.import_module with the name as a literal, and a call of urlopen, urlretrieve or
asyncio.open_connection outside a '#' comment and outside a string. Matching import
statements and calls, not names, keeps the tests quiet that fake a download (a fake
function, mock.patch of a name in a string). It allows exactly one file, by exact path:
tools/duty-data-generator/generate.py, the dev-time generator that downloads the duty
tables from two public sources (XIVAPI and the thewakingsands datamining CSV) and the only
Python file that opens a connection. The shared-calibration tools need no allowance: their
Python only reads saved gh output from files; the gh calls that reach GitHub are in the
shell scripts and workflows beside them.
A rule may name the files it does not apply to. 'allow_paths' lists
repository-relative, forward-slash FILE paths matched exactly (not by file
or directory name); 'allow_path_prefixes' lists directory prefixes that must
end in '/'. Each allowance lifts only its own rule, and every one must be
explained in docs/privacy-boundary.md (NET-006/NET-007: sections 8.2, 8.3, 8.4 and 8.6; NET-010:
the development-time downloads named under section 8).
A rule id may be declared more than once when every entry names a distinct
'variant' (lower-case token). Violations are still reported under the id; each
entry has its own pattern and its own allowances, so the shared-calibration
client may name its CDN hosts but not the speech host, the online-speech
client the speech host but not the CDN hosts, and the update-check client the
content host but neither the CDN hosts nor the speech host.

rules.message: 读取其他进程内存被禁止（含 Toolhelp32ReadProcessMemory、Nt/ZwReadVirtualMemory、NtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64 与转储进程内存的 MiniDumpWriteDump） / reading another process's memory is forbidden (including Toolhelp32ReadProcessMemory, Nt/ZwReadVirtualMemory, NtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64 and MiniDumpWriteDump, which dumps it)
写入其他进程内存被禁止 / writing another process's memory is forbidden

在其他进程中分配内存或修改其内存保护被禁止（VirtualAllocEx、VirtualAlloc2、VirtualProtectEx、Nt/ZwAllocateVirtualMemory、Nt/ZwProtectVirtualMemory） / allocating memory in, or changing the memory protection of, another process is forbidden (VirtualAllocEx, VirtualAlloc2, VirtualProtectEx, Nt/ZwAllocateVirtualMemory, Nt/ZwProtectVirtualMemory)
远程线程注入被禁止（CreateRemoteThread / CreateRemoteThreadEx） / remote thread injection is forbidden (CreateRemoteThread / CreateRemoteThreadEx)
全局/远程消息钩子被禁止 / installing Windows hooks is forbidden

底层注入原语被禁止（Nt/ZwWriteVirtualMemory、Nt/ZwCreateThreadEx、RtlCreateUserThread、QueueUserAPC / QueueUserAPC2、Nt/ZwQueueApcThread） / low-level injection primitives are forbidden (Nt/ZwWriteVirtualMemory, Nt/ZwCreateThreadEx, RtlCreateUserThread, QueueUserAPC / QueueUserAPC2, Nt/ZwQueueApcThread)

禁止打开游戏进程或其线程的句柄，或为此取得调试特权（OpenProcess、OpenThread、按窗口取进程句柄的 GetProcessHandleFromHwnd、逐个打开进程的 NtGetNextProcess、DebugActiveProcess、Process.EnterDebugMode）；只允许不打开任何进程句柄的查询：内核进程表快照（进程编号、映像名、创建时间）与单个进程的映像路径查询、系统 TCP 表、系统路由表，以及桌面端点选游戏窗口时读取前台窗口所属的进程编号 / opening a handle to another process or one of its threads, or taking the debug privilege to do so (OpenProcess, OpenThread, GetProcessHandleFromHwnd, which opens one from a window, NtGetNextProcess, which opens one process after another, DebugActiveProcess, Process.EnterDebugMode), is forbidden; only queries that open no process handle are allowed: the kernel process-table snapshot (ids, image names, creation times) and its per-process image-path lookup, the system TCP table, the system routing table, and the Desktop reading the foreground window's process id while the player picks the game window

禁止使用 Process.MainModule / Process.Modules（含属性模式中的写法）：二者内部以 PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ 打开目标进程句柄并读取其模块表，请改用内核进程表（ProcessImagePath） / Process.MainModule and Process.Modules are forbidden, property patterns included: they open a handle to the target with PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ and read its module table; use the kernel process table (ProcessImagePath) instead

禁止使用会打开目标进程句柄的 Process 成员（StartTime、HasExited、WaitForExit、Kill、Handle、GetProcessById 等，含属性模式与对象初始化器中的写法，以及 PowerShell 管道中不带点号点名这些成员的写法，如 Get-Process | Select-Object StartTime、ForEach-Object Kill、Where-Object HasExited 及其别名，不分大小写）：对游戏进程而言这就是打开它的句柄；游戏只允许进程存在性检查与内核进程表。只有驱动本软件自身进程的父进程看门狗、测试与脚本按精确路径放行 / Process members that open a handle to their process (StartTime, HasExited, WaitForExit, Kill, Handle, GetProcessById, ..., property patterns, object initialisers and PowerShell pipelines that name the member without a dot, such as Get-Process | Select-Object StartTime, ForEach-Object Kill or Where-Object HasExited and their aliases, in any letter case, included) are forbidden: on the game they are a handle to the game, which may only be checked for existence and read through the kernel process table; only the parent watchdog and the tests and scripts that drive our own processes are allowed, by exact path
Deucalion 注入式钩子必须保持关闭 / the Deucalion injected hook must stay disabled
禁止使用 Deucalion 注入式抓包 API / the Deucalion injected-capture API must not be used
禁止引用/分发 Deucalion 注入载荷 / the Deucalion injection payload must not be referenced or shipped
禁止调用注入载荷的加载入口 / the injection payload's loader entry points must not be called

禁止发送数据包（含 libpcap 的发送队列、Packet.dll 的 PacketSendPacket 与 SharpPcap 的 SendPacket / SendQueue） / sending packets is forbidden, including libpcap's send queue, Packet.dll's PacketSendPacket and SharpPcap's SendPacket / SendQueue (capture is strictly passive)
禁止注入数据包 / injecting packets is forbidden (capture is strictly passive)
只允许 Npcap/WinPCap 抓包模式，禁止 RawSocket 回退 / only the Npcap (WinPCap) monitor type is allowed, no raw-socket fallback
只允许 Npcap/WinPCap 抓包，禁止使用 raw socket 抓包实现 / only the Npcap (WinPCap) capture socket is allowed, never the raw-socket one
禁止把原始报文写入抓包文件（含 SharpPcap 的 CaptureFileWriterDevice） / dumping raw packets to a capture file is forbidden, including SharpPcap's CaptureFileWriterDevice

禁止直接加载 pcap 原生库（DllImport / LibraryImport / NativeLibrary.Load / LoadLibrary / QLibrary，含库名写在常量或下一行的写法），抓包只经由 SharpPcap 的 Npcap 设备 / no direct use of the pcap native libraries (DllImport / LibraryImport / NativeLibrary.Load / LoadLibrary / QLibrary, including a library name held in a constant or written on the next line); capture goes through SharpPcap's Npcap device only
禁止 HTTP 监听器，进程间通信只允许命名管道 / no HTTP listener; IPC is Named Pipe only
禁止 TCP 监听器，进程间通信只允许命名管道 / no TCP listener; IPC is Named Pipe only
禁止 WebSocket，进程间通信只允许命名管道 / no WebSocket; IPC is Named Pipe only

禁止内嵌 Web 服务器（Kestrel、UseKestrel、Microsoft.AspNetCore、Web 项目 SDK Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web、WebApplication） / no embedded web server (Kestrel, UseKestrel, Microsoft.AspNetCore, the web project SDK Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web, WebApplication)
桌面端不得监听任何端口或管道，只作为命名管道客户端 / the Desktop process must not listen; it is a Named Pipe client only

禁止外发网络请求（HttpClient、HttpMessageInvoker、SocketsHttpHandler、WebRequest、WinHTTP、WinINet、URLDownloadToFile、QNetworkAccessManager 等 HTTP 客户端）；例外只有共享校准获取客户端、在线语音客户端与更新检查客户端（docs/privacy-boundary.md §8.2、§8.3、§8.4、§8.6） / no outbound network requests (HttpClient, HttpMessageInvoker, SocketsHttpHandler, WebRequest, WinHTTP, WinINet, URLDownloadToFile, QNetworkAccessManager and the other HTTP clients); the only exceptions are the shared-calibration fetch client, the online-speech client and the update-check client (docs/privacy-boundary.md sections 8.2, 8.3, 8.4 and 8.6)
共享校准 CDN 的主机名只允许出现在获取客户端、公开仓库脚本目录与开发期数据生成器 / the shared-calibration CDN host names may only appear in the fetch client, tools/shared-calibration/ and the dev-time duty-data generator

内容分发主机名只允许出现在共享校准获取客户端、更新检查客户端、公开仓库脚本目录与开发期数据生成器（docs/privacy-boundary.md §8.2、§8.4、§8.6） / the content host name may only appear in the shared-calibration fetch client, the update-check client, tools/shared-calibration/ and the dev-time duty-data generator (docs/privacy-boundary.md sections 8.2, 8.4 and 8.6)
在线语音服务的主机名只允许出现在在线语音客户端（docs/privacy-boundary.md §8.3） / the online-speech host name may only appear in the online-speech client (docs/privacy-boundary.md section 8.3)

禁止直接使用网络：TCP / UDP / QUIC 套接字（TcpClient、UdpClient、Socket、Winsock、Qt 套接字类）、域名解析（Dns、QHostInfo、getaddrinfo）、Ping 与 SmtpClient；既不得外连也不得监听；进程间通信只用命名管道，三个出站客户端也只经由 HTTP 客户端 / no direct network use: TCP, UDP or QUIC sockets (TcpClient, UdpClient, Socket, Winsock, the Qt socket classes), name resolution (Dns, QHostInfo, getaddrinfo), Ping and SmtpClient, neither connecting nor listening; IPC is Named Pipe only and the three outbound clients go through the HTTP client only

禁止脚本、安装程序、QML 与桌面端自行下载或请求网络资源（Invoke-WebRequest、Invoke-RestMethod、BITS、Inno Setup 下载页（不分大小写）、XMLHttpRequest 与 MSXML2.XMLHTTP、远程 source、把远程地址交给 QML 引擎的 load / setSource）；唯一例外是安装程序在缺少 Npcap 时从 npcap.com 下载固定版本、校验 SHA-256 的官方安装程序，创建下载页的那一行带有登记在案的行内标记（Npcap 的免费许可证不允许随包分发，见 README.md 与 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md） / scripts, the installer, QML and the Desktop must not download or request network resources themselves (Invoke-WebRequest, Invoke-RestMethod, BITS, Inno Setup download pages in any letter case, XMLHttpRequest and MSXML2.XMLHTTP, a remote source, load / setSource handing the QML engine a remote address); the one exception is the installer downloading the official Npcap installer (pinned version, SHA-256 checked) from npcap.com when Npcap is missing, whose one line creating the download page carries a pinned marker, because Npcap's free licence forbids bundling it (see README.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

QML 与其中的 JavaScript 不得加载远程资源（给 source 赋远程地址、import 远程模块、url 属性取远程地址、Qt.resolvedUrl / Qt.include 远程地址） / QML and its JavaScript must not load remote resources (a remote address assigned to source, an import of a remote module, a url property bound to a remote address, Qt.resolvedUrl / Qt.include of a remote address)

脚本与工作流不得用下载命令联网（curl、wget、iwr、irm、bitsadmin、certutil -urlcache，含 if / then / do 等 shell 关键字、sudo、!、反引号、cmd /c、Start-Process、调用运算符 & 之后与带路径的写法） / scripts and workflows must not fetch network resources with download commands (curl, wget, iwr, irm, bitsadmin, certutil -urlcache, including after if / then / do and the other shell keywords, sudo, !, a backtick, cmd /c, Start-Process or the call operator &, and with a path in front)

禁止以 XML 读取接口从远程地址加载（XmlDocument / XDocument / XElement 的 Load、XmlReader.Create、XmlTextReader、XPathDocument，含 PowerShell 的 $doc.Load(…) 与 [XDocument]::Load(…)、MSXML 的 load，不分大小写）：这些接口会自行下载所给的地址；只允许读取本机文件 / loading XML from a remote address is forbidden (Load of XmlDocument / XDocument / XElement, XmlReader.Create, XmlTextReader, XPathDocument, including PowerShell's $doc.Load(...) and [XDocument]::Load(...) and MSXML's load, in any letter case): these readers download the address they are given; only local files may be read

Python 脚本不得自行联网（导入网络模块 urllib.request、urllib3、http.client、requests、httpx、aiohttp、socket、ftplib、smtplib、poplib、imaplib、nntplib、telnetlib、xmlrpc.client、websockets，含 __import__ / importlib.import_module，以及调用 urlopen / urlretrieve 与 asyncio.open_connection）；唯一例外是开发期从公开来源下载任务数据表的 tools/duty-data-generator/generate.py / Python scripts must not reach the network themselves (importing a network module: urllib.request, urllib3, http.client, requests, httpx, aiohttp, socket, ftplib, smtplib, poplib, imaplib, nntplib, telnetlib, xmlrpc.client or websockets, __import__ and importlib.import_module included, or calling urlopen / urlretrieve or asyncio.open_connection); the one exception is tools/duty-data-generator/generate.py, the dev-time generator that downloads the duty tables from public sources

禁止任何形式的游戏自动化/模拟输入（含 SendKeys、向窗口投递消息的 PostMessage / SendMessage，以及向主窗口发送关闭消息的 Process.CloseMainWindow） / synthetic input and game automation are forbidden, including SendKeys, posting window messages with PostMessage / SendMessage, and Process.CloseMainWindow, which posts a close message to a process's main window
